decision: Until a trusted ValidatedEncodingPlan exists, disable the production arbitrary-provider to ProgrammeOutputBinding path and do not permit CLI staging/finalize from PreparedJobInput alone.
current_gap: Implementation reports PreparedJobInput::bind_output accepts caller OutputProvider; no complete parent plan/provider-set receipt exists.

production_boundary.EncodingProfile: six dimensions; resolve_selected_profile is admission only, not provider validation
production_boundary.OutputProvider: private plan-derived value, not a caller authority
production_boundary.ProgrammeOutputBinding: only parent plan constructor may mint it
production_boundary.CLI staging/finalize: requires unforgeable production binding; without plan, no production route

test_harness: Keep synthetic provider/binding behind cfg(test), internal test helper or non-default dev-only test-support feature; production CLI must not enable it.
future_plan_minimum: ProgrammeId/resource SHA/config SHA/N from same PreparedJobInput
approved package/F15 manifest identities plus actual selected provider receipt lineage
typed AttemptId and separate opaque staging owner/destination bound to same programme
pre_io_reject: caller provider or hash differs from private plan projection
owner_boundary: F15 proposals/receipts become logical output only at existing GTC parent commit; no early leaf commit, overwrite authority or filesystem rollback claim.
scope: API authority boundary only; does not create ValidatedEncodingPlan or certify runtime publication.
